colored-list.looks: A list with large styled markers: bullets, numbers, numbers in circles or bullets in circles.
colored-list.use: A list of points or steps that needs bigger or circled markers than a plain bulleted list.
colored-list.avoid: A short plain list inside copy: put a <ul> in Custom Text. Steps that each need a heading: use numbered cards.

fields.listStyle: bullet (default), number, circle-number (numbers in coloured circles) or circle-bullet. Steps → circle-number.

fields.itemText: One point: a sentence or two; bold a lead-in if the source does.
fields.markerText: Optional; replaces this item's number or bullet, e.g. a letter. Leave empty for automatic numbering.
